design_description: A playful, modern football jersey designed for Axel's bachelor party in Palermo, Italy. The soft pink base features dynamic diagonal streaks and sharp geometric patterns in black and darker pink, creating a sporty, energetic look. Black collar and sleeve trims provide contrast, while the custom EVG AXEL 2026 logo incorporates Palermo's architecture and a palm tree. The back features bold black PLAYER lettering, an oversized number 10, and a subtle PALERMO inscription beneath the collar.
